scope: Own-method study, post-correction. Separate source diversity, paired robustness, discretization, runtime, native planning and kinematic closed loops. No external comparison or new PhysX result.

public.reference: 300 new generated geometries, 100 re-registered SuMa road submaps across 11 sequences, 100 reused indoor inputs across 49 layouts. Sparse public references remain proxies. No score-based exclusion.

mechanism.pairing: Identical geometry, point deletion, standardized Z perturbations and reference within each noise triplet. GP observation-noise model stays 0.02m; risk input variance follows known injected noise. Tests robustness of this configured pipeline, not sensor-noise estimation. Flat seeds are repeated noise trials, one geometry group.

discretization.scope: Measured dense analytic surface -> occupancy/BGK/SEB, no GP. Zero injected noise to isolate discretization. Same 121 physical centers and 72 physical headings across all nine settings; coarse yaw layer selected by containing bin, never change the oracle query set.

scaling.scope: BgkSebEstimator.compute synchronized wall clock including transfers/result materialization, not ROS latency. Nine paired workloads, shared desktop GPU, no concurrent experiment jobs.

planning.scope: Actual executePlannerJob static queries, independent dense geometry validation, measured-only new maps; repeats do not create additional independent queries.

navigation.scope: Production C++ planner/control callbacks, rolling time/current obstacle returns, first-order bicycle plant. Not PhysX, suspension/contact, SLAM/DDS concurrency or proof of dynamic-map ghost clearing.

gates.interpretation: Engineering screening criteria, not standards or physical certification; no post-result threshold selection. Empty accepted domain is not a success.

statistics.unit: Generated geometry or public source group, not cells, headings, masks or timing repetitions. Road has 11 groups, indoor 49. Report pooled confusion denominators separately from equal-group estimates.
statistics.paired_noise: Within-geometry difference in RMSE/CRPS/FNR against zero noise, cluster bootstrap of differences. Not an external-method comparison or significance claim for thousands of correlated poses.
statistics.precision: Report cluster-bootstrap intervals and cumulative interval width vs group count as descriptive precision, not a post-hoc stopping rule. All prespecified samples retained.

interpretation: GP diagnostics enabled with defaults 384 train/96 inducing. Navigation uses measured-only surface, GP refinement and unknown completion off. Report this deployment boundary rather than attributing navigation to unused GP predictions. Retain old v3 arrays and source fingerprints.
